inputs.action: Supply production App ID and verify allowed domain plus connect-only settings

inputs.whereToConfigure: NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_APP_ID and dashboard allowed origin https://otherbridge.io

inputs.action: Select hosting, secret custody mechanism, operator and recovery destinations
inputs.why: Hosting and secret manager are owner choices; runtime interface is deployment-neutral
inputs.whereToConfigure: Deployment environment and restricted secret namespace

inputs.why: Internal review is not independent certification
inputs.whereToConfigure: Release evidence; externalAuditHashes in future receipt

inputs.action: Commission web/API pentest on an approved private target
inputs.why: No external pentest was performed by this milestone

inputs.action: Complete provider, OSS license, commercial-use, terms and privacy reviews
inputs.why: Technical source review is not legal approval

inputs.action: Decide whether to authorize the exact candidate after external gates close
